reading.cost: The page offers the option to join for free. It also mentions a subscription that unlocks access to more than 10,000 courses, and purchasing a Certificate, which gives access to all course materials including graded assignments. No price is given.
covers: Common AI terminology, including neural networks, machine learning, deep learning and data science
What AI realistically can and cannot do
Spotting opportunities to apply AI to problems in your own organization
What it feels like to build machine learning and data science projects
Working with an AI team and building an AI strategy
Ethical and societal discussions surrounding AI
Workflow of a machine learning project
Choosing an AI project and the technical tools AI teams use
reading.format: An online course on Coursera, listed as beginner level and available in 27 languages. It is made up of video lessons grouped into sections, some marked optional, with graded assignments. A certificate is available on purchase.
reading.summary: AI for Everyone is an online course from DeepLearning.AI offered on Coursera that explains artificial intelligence in largely non-technical terms. It covers common AI terminology, what AI can and cannot do, how to find opportunities to apply AI inside an organization, and how to work with an AI team and set an AI strategy. It also addresses ethical and societal questions around AI. Completing the course and its graded assignments leads to an electronic Certificate that can be printed or added to a LinkedIn profile.
reading.audience: The page says the course is for people who want their organization to get better at using AI, especially non-technical colleagues. It adds that engineers can take it too, to learn the business side of AI.
reading.prerequisites: None stated. The page lists the course as beginner level.
